SELECT mp.*, IFNULL( mm.moduleNum, 0 ) AS moduleNum, IFNULL( me.endpointNum, 0 ) AS endpointNum, IFNULL( me.assetNum, 0 ) AS assetNum, IFNULL( msg.alertNum, 0 ) AS alertNum, IFNULL( sta.starred, 0 ) AS starred FROM monitor_project mp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, count( 1 ) AS moduleNum FROM monitor_module GROUP BY project_id ) mm ON mm.project_id = mp.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.project_id, count( 1 ) AS endpointNum, count( DISTINCT e.asset_id ) AS assetNum FROM monitor_endpoint e LEFT JOIN monitor_module m ON e.module_id = m.id GROUP BY m.project_id ) me ON mp.id = me.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, count( 1 ) AS alertNum FROM alert_message_active WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id ) msg ON mp.id = msg.project_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT IF(COUNT(1) > 0, 1, 0) AS starred,tid FROM sys_user_starred WHERE TYPE = "project" AND uid = #{params.uid} GROUP BY tid) sta ON mp.id = sta.tid
mp.id in
#{id}
AND locate(#{params.name} , mp.name)
AND
sta.starred = #{params.starred}
sta.starred IS NULL
ORDER BY mp.id
SELECT me.* FROM monitor_project mp RIGHT JOIN monitor_module mm ON mp.id = mm.project_id RIGHT JOIN monitor_endpoint me ON mm.id = me.module_id WHERE mp.id = #{projectId}

SELECT DISTINCT asset.* FROM monitor_project mp RIGHT JOIN monitor_module mm ON mp.id = mm.project_id RIGHT JOIN monitor_endpoint me ON mm.id = me.module_id RIGHT JOIN asset_asset asset ON me.asset_id = asset.id WHERE mp.id = #{projectId}

SELECT DISTINCT dc.* FROM monitor_project mp RIGHT JOIN monitor_module mm ON mp.id = mm.project_id RIGHT JOIN monitor_endpoint me ON mm.id = me.module_id RIGHT JOIN asset_asset asset ON me.asset_id = asset.id RIGHT JOIN dc dc ON asset.dc_id = dc.id WHERE mp.id = #{projectId}
